oracle_cmd: cd $TMPDIR/oagen/inorder && for f in *.plan; do tr '|' '\n' < "$f" | awk -v f="$f" '{i=index($0,"="); print f "\t" substr($0,1,i-1) "\t" substr($0,i+1)}'; done | awk -F'\t' '$2=="steps"{print $1 "\t" $3}' | while IFS=$'\t' read f s; do grep -qxF "$s" gm_steps.txt || echo "$f"; done; for f in *.plan; do tr '|' '\n' < "$f" | awk -v f="$f" '{i=index($0,"="); print f "\t" substr($0,1,i-1) "\t" substr($0,i+1)}'; done | awk -F'\t' '$2=="stage"{S[$1]=$3} $2=="next_stage"{N[$1]=$3} END{for(f in N) if((N[f]".plan") in S && S[N[f]".plan"]<=S[f]) print (W=="target"?N[f]".plan":f)}' W=src
